verdict.rationale: The Apple M4 Max is a hardware system-on-chip. An official MCP server is a software or service integration, so the question is a category error for silicon. Nothing in the evidence shows the chip shipping any MCP server; the llms.txt probe returned 404, and the ML framework mentions (MLX, Metal) concern compute, not agent connectivity.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can connect an agent via an official MCP server
